backgroundFiltersSchema.pattern: Python regular expression, full match, case-insensitive, on the redacted target (<CATEGORY>\relative path; a registry value as <HKCU>\key\value name)
backgroundFiltersSchema.reason: why the change is another actor's background activity
backgroundFiltersSchema.evidencedBy: the observed run whose artefacts evidence it; adding or changing a filter is a rule change (HUM-07, A3)
backgroundFiltersSchema.entry: optional: any (default), file, directory, key or value; restricts the filter to that entry kind

registryMarker.retention: No automatic deletion; author approval required for each cleanup
registryMarker.dataEvidence: Run ID is encoded in the exact key; verify value payload when the trace export exposes it

unknownOpcodePolicy: unknown; no blanket provider or PID exclusion
externalConnectionPolicy: Studio has no authorised network destination; any attributed connection is undeclared
framing: An observed run measures what running Studio leaves on the machine, whichever layer does it. Effects issued in the Studio process by the WPF/.NET runtime, the Windows text-input framework or an in-process driver are app effects; only OS records that observe the process itself (prefetch, background-activity, compatibility stores) are other-actor records.

declaredAppSurfaces.residualRisk: The user's IME composition-window position (HKCU) is updated by the text-input framework on the Studio UI thread.

declaredAppSurfaces.scope: write-only-within-file: WriteFile into the existing file; no create, delete, rename or set-information
declaredAppSurfaces.residualRisk: The GPU driver's per-application timestamp store (machine-wide) is updated by the in-process driver.

declaredAppSurfaces.scope: keys and values added or updated during a confirmed export; no removal
declaredAppSurfaces.residualRisk: The Windows common save dialog (comdlg32, in Studio's process) records each confirmed file in the user's per-extension recent list and the last folder per application, as for every application that uses the dialog. Studio itself stores no folder or setting.

otherActorRecords.timing: at or after the owned process's ProcessEnd event
